tooltip.jaymospowers.climate_charm.hot_s: A stone warmed at the fire, wrapped in wool: keeps the cold off while worn at the belt.
tooltip.jaymospowers.climate_charm.cold_: Clay kept cool in a stream: keeps the heat off while worn at the belt.
tooltip.jaymospowers.climate_charm.equin: Sun on one face, snow on the other: keeps the cold and the heat off while worn at the belt.
